verdict.rationale: Runpod docs explicitly state Pods are billed by the second with no ingress/egress fees, and Serverless is pay-per-second with billing running from worker start until fully stopped, rounded to the nearest second — directly matching the story of per-second billing only while running. Multiple docs corroborate scale-to-zero behavior for flex workers, meaning no charges when idle. Missing for 10: independent third-party billing audit or user account confirming exact second-level charges in practice.
